jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React & Node.js)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Engineer to lead architecture on our cloud applications. You will design resilient APIs, build high-performance React frontends, and collaborate with product teams on high-impact scalable services.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience with React, TypeScript/JavaScript, and Node.js.
- Strong understanding of REST APIs, database schemas, and microservices.
- Experience with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.
- Passion for clean architecture, automated testing, and developer experience.

jobs.title: Lead AI / ML Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Lead the next generation of AI-driven recruiting and enterprise productivity intelligence. In this role, you will architect multimodal LLM pipelines, implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks, and deploy secure enterprise AI workflows.

Requirements:
- Deep expertise in foundation models, Gemini API, PyTorch, or Hugging Face.
- Experience deploying scalable LLM systems in production.
- Proven background in software engineering and distributed computing.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (Design Systems)
jobs.location: Cebu IT Park, Cebu City (Remote / Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Join our design team to craft state-of-the-art user experiences for enterprise workflow products. You will maintain our design system, facilitate user research, and build interactive prototypes.

Requirements:
- Proven portfolio showcasing high-fidelity UI/UX design and design tokens.
- Mastery of Figma, component architecture, and accessibility (WCAG AA).
- Strong communication skills and cross-functional leadership.
